transcript.text: Cloud engineer or devops engineer what
is the difference Cloud Engineers are
responsible for Designing planning and
maintaining Cloud infrastructure their
focus is mainly on the cloud services
including storage networking databases
and security to ensure scalability
reliability and performance of cloud
systems day-to-day tasks of a cloud
engineer includes setting up
infrastructure on the cloud or migrating
applications from on Prem to the cloud
whereas devops Engineers focus on
automating the software development and
deployment process implementing cicd
pipeline monitoring and lot more tools
used by devops Engineers include Docker
and kubernetes for calization gitlab and
Jenkins for cicd promus grafana for
monitoring Etc to know more about cloud
and devops subscribe to Cloud Channel
